# Contributing

Thank you for considering contributing to Laravel Page Builder!

## Bug Reports

To encourage active collaboration, pull requests are preferred over bug reports. If you submit a bug report, please include a descriptive title, steps to reproduce, and your PHP and Laravel versions.

## Security Vulnerabilities

If you discover a security vulnerability, please email [dipak@coderstm.com](mailto:dipak@coderstm.com). All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.

## Coding Style

Laravel Page Builder follows the PSR-12 coding standard. Please run Pint before submitting pull requests:

```bash
vendor/bin/pint
```

## Running Tests

Run the test suite using Composer:

```bash
composer test
```
